title: Aerial Kiteboarding School
specs: Boat-assisted lessons launch from newest and largest boats in Howe Sound
Employs 3 certified level 2 instructors out of less than 200 worldwide
A 5mm seam sealed full wetsuit or thicker and booties required for all kiteboarding lessons
Group courses run May 1 to Sept 15 yearly, must be 18-60 yrs old and 120 to 260 lbs
Can accommodate upwards of 50 students a day with 10 water vessels
includes: Boat rental, gas, driver, gear rental and instruction included in lesson prices
Life jackets and paddles included with canoe rentals
gap: Exact age minimum for private lessons not stated
blurb: Guests learn kiteboarding from certified instructors using boat-assisted launches in Howe Sound or from a sand bar. Lessons include gear rental, wetsuits, and instruction tailored to skill level. The school offers private, semi-private, advanced, and foil lessons, as well as canoe rentals and tours.
extraNote: Lessons must be cancelled or rescheduled at least 48 hours prior or may be voided · Lessons cancelled due to wind will be rescheduled · Lessons purchased in a previous year are non-refundable but transferable or credit · Downtown location at 37813 2 Ave, Squamish, BC; lessons launch from nearby boat launch or Squamish Spit by request · March to November for water lessons; May 1 to Sept 15 for group courses

quotes.text: Dan Davie I an awesome time with Aerial Kitesurfing! I had done some kiting a long time ago and was looking to get back into it and the team were really helpful. They gave me lots of different lesson options and were more than happy to answer my many questions. We had Dan as our instructor and he was awesome. I went with a friend of mine who was a beginner and we learned all the skill and theory we needed to but did so on the water which was way more proactive than the way I was taught in the past! Highly recommend grabbing a lesson with these guys. - 1/03/2022 read moreread less

Arno Knapitsch I am a beginner, who didn’t kite the last three years, so I had to refresh a few things and gain some confidence again. I’ve booked a three hour private lesson, and went out today with Alex and Alina. I felt very well taken care of, the instructions were always clear and I felt always safe. It was a really great day in a stunning location and I even managed to learn how to kite toeside for a little bit. I would definitely go again with them if I come here next time. And the hot tub after the session was a very welcome treat. - 7/01/2023 read moreread less

Matt Kasteel Aerial kiteboarding is amazing! My wife and I did lessons with them a few years ago, and it was incredible! The lessons are done from a boat, so you get A TON more time to ride compared to lessons at a beach where you lose a lot of time walking back up wind. Since doing the lessons, I've purchased gear from Aerial and had them repair my kite, and the service is amazing every time. Thanks to Dan for getting my kite fixed in one day so I could get back out and ride again right away! - 9/08/2022 read moreread less
